subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Which open candidate PR should own the fix for cron-sourced main-session wakes being skipped as disabled?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but three open PRs touch overlapping cron/heartbeat behavior and need a human choice before the issue can close.

options.title: Review and land one candidate
options.body: Pick the most complete PR, require proof for the main-session cron wake path, and close the other candidates as superseded after merge.

options.title: Ask contributors to consolidate
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the open PR authors to converge on one branch before maintainer review.

options.title: Close candidates and queue a maintainer fix
options.body: If none of the open PRs is acceptable, close them with rationale and create one maintainer-owned repair path.

recommendation.title: Review and land one candidate
recommendation.body: Pick the most complete PR, require proof for the main-session cron wake path, and close the other candidates as superseded after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame points to this recent contributor on both central files, making them the best available routing owner from local history.
